newsitem.title: USA: Superior says buys firm for $6.82 mln.
newsitem.headline: Superior says buys firm for $6.82 mln.

text.p: Superior Consultant Holdings Corp said it acquired Kaufman Group Inc, a consultant to managed care clients and physician groups based in San Diego, for about $6.82 million in cash and stock.
The transaction will be accounted for as an acquisition, and is expected to be accretive for 1997, Superior said.

"This merger is a significant first step in executing our acquisition strategy. We intend to pursue other acquisitions that will keep us at the forefront of healthcare consulting," said Chief Executive Richard Helppie.
Superior said it raised $42 million in its October 1996 initial public offering.
